items.title: Fred Lipsius interviewed by Monk Rowe. Boston, Massachusetts, July 25, 2018
items.q: I want you to play piano to back up Artie on this first album, on a Randy Newman tune, ‘Old Man,’ about an old man dying.

ctx.x: Well it certainly worked, I can tell you that.

Well I’ve got to tell you that what happened from that, you know, after we did the album and I left the band a year later in ’72, I was with them ’67 to ’71. A year later Roy Halee that was Simon & Garfunkel’s producer, they asked him to be producer on “Bridge Over Troubled Water” and some other stuff. Not all the albums, but he was an engineer. He was a great engineer and he was a trumpet player too. Classical. I didn’t know that. He was the first one to double the horns, great ears, great enthusiasm, he was…
